name: Inami (Wakayama, Japan)
description: A maroon field charged at the centre with the Inami town emblem in white: an outlined leaf-like loop with curled ends.
history: Municipal flag of Inami, a town in Wakayama Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field.

features.role: Inami town emblem — an outlined leaf-like loop with curled ends
